scope: Final native observability validation and package provenance only

swiftHost.source: Actual native spool and token authority source, with minimal Flutter type stubs in a temporary SwiftPM harness
swiftHost.boundary: Host execution does not prove live PushKit, actual Flutter channel attachment, or execution of the iOS RunnerTests wrapper test. The actual iOS app target separately compiled successfully.

causeInterop.before: Android shared-fixture sanitizer and actual native capability wrapper: two tests failed. Swift shared-fixture test: two assertion failures across attempt and authority contexts.
causeInterop.after: Closed wire cause maps to internal reason; dedicated trace/request/operation/parent IDs survive; legacy internal reason remains supported; private unknown values are discarded.

consentRetry.before: Failed native configure(true,E) prevented the identical request from retrying after storage recovered.
consentRetry.after: Requested consent is separate from effective capture. Capture stays disabled after failed writes; identical request can retry, while stale/equal-conflicting re-enable remains refused.

retentionAndAuthority: Native drain is non-destructive until durable diagnostic ACK; canonical call-journal ACK cannot remove diagnostic evidence.
Protected private trace lookup survives diagnostic ACK and restart, normalizes compact/canonical private handles, and refuses disabled or expired bindings.
Diagnostic sink failures preserve canonical answer persistence and audio admission.
Malformed optional push diagnostics do not alter the existing strict call authority parser.
Native schema copies match the shared allowlists, including authorityKind.

ios.treeHashAlgorithm: SHA256 of sorted relative file path + NUL + lowercase file SHA256 + newline for each file in the app tree

deviceValidation.boundedWorkerActions: The pinned iPhone diagnostics sheet was opened without changing consent. One explicitly authorized Pixel offline preflight ended graph_unavailable in the superseded native-disabled lab APK; its archive was captured before WiFi restoration. This proves durable offline diagnostic capture, not a network-caused failure or successful calling. No external contact or completed call was initiated by this worker.

distribution.appStore: This observability build has not been published
distribution.playStore: This observability build has not been published
distribution.labInstalls: Performed by root; this worker built packages only

limitations: Actual RunnerTests iOS wrapper test is added with the shared fixture bundled; it was not executed by the host Swift harness.
When native persistence fails, capture is disabled in memory and synchronization remains pending; durable opt-out is not claimed until persistence succeeds.
Successful packaging and native tests alone do not prove end-to-end call or telemetry delivery.

supersededPackages.reason: Dart-to-Go request envelope and diagnostics status display corrected before final packages.

supersededAndroidNativeDisabled.reason: Lab APK packaging omitted the existing explicit native Gradle enable flag. The original working deploy recipe supplies this flag; native production defaults remain unchanged. This is not attributed to the original beta incident.

nativeTestsNotRepeatedForBuildConfigurat: All78 native tests already ran with -PenableAndroidNativeCalls=true; no native source changed. The corrected packaged dex was inspected separately.

subsequentRuntimeRebuild.reason: Persist canonical trace aliases for late Flutter/native records and prioritize terminal/initial media diagnostic uploads.
